title: ר' תנחום בר אמי

paragraphs: R' Tanhum bar Ammi did not rule in R' Mani of Tyre's locality: Sanhedrin 5b. R' Tanhum bar Ammi expounded that one may moisten wheat on Passover. They said to him, “But R' Mana is here.” Tosafot, Eruvin 62b, write that he was a pupil-colleague.
